substeps.caption: Tray A at the opening with a Hanwha QNE-8011R (turret) on each of its two camera posts, where the HQ/Wide heads were. Under a roof assumed at the opening's top (drawn see-through): the pair at the middle back (an Axis M3086-V mini dome and the M5075-G PTZ, here turned to the CubXL's holder seat), a mini dome in the strip under the header looking back, and one looking straight down. Simple shapes at each model's published size.
